audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer rated every lane phase 'Skill' while the content layer and the packet both give you levels 1-4 outright.
audit.why: Pick a Card is 200 range — he has to be inside auto range to land the Gold Card, and your 815 ball taxes him from outside it. There is no lane threat until then.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3] sides moved to Orianna with whys rewritten around the 200-vs-815 range gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes said 'level 6 doubles your lane presence' and 'Luden's makes Q-W a third of a health bar' — the level 6 swing here is HIS, and the second claim is a magnitude with no source.
audit.why: Destiny is 170s at rank 1, 5500 range, reveals every enemy champion and then Gates him anywhere in 1.5 seconds. Your R is a 110s fight tool that does nothing about that.
audit.corrected: Spike line and breakdown.mid rewritten around Destiny's 170s and the reveal-then-Gate sequence.
sources: brief enemyKit R cd 170/140/110, range 5500, text

audit.whatIsWrong: The flagged missing interaction was never on the page: Pick a Card is an auto-attack reset, so the card-select animation is the tell and the stun arrives with the damage in one motion. breakdown.cooldowns also contained no cooldown number.
audit.why: A player watching for 'the cast' steps back too late. The correct cue is the wind-up, and the correct distance is outside his auto range.
audit.corrected: report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, tradeBad and breakdown.cooldowns now state the reset tell with Pick a Card 6s / 200 range, Wild Cards 5-6s, Destiny 170s.
sources: brief enemyKit W flags autoReset/hardCC, cd 6, range 200

edits.after: Track Pick a Card (Gold): it is only 200 range, so it lands on an auto. The card select animation is the tell — step outside auto range while he is picking.

edits.before: Win the auto-weave levels: passive stacks hurt, ball placement zones, and Q-W trades punish every wave contact. Mana is the only brake.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are yours: Pick a Card needs him inside 200, and your 815 ball taxes every last-hit from outside that range entirely.

edits.before: From Luden's you run rivers: shove the wave, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball on your jungler doubles every gank.
edits.after: At 6 the map changes: Destiny is 170s at rank 1 and reveals everyone before Gate lands, so ping the channel, shove for tempo, and stop diving him for the level.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-W slow push you crash on roam timers — your clear is instant from Luden's and the ball travels with the shove. Crash timing: shove with a destination in mind; mid waves are bus tickets, not chores.
edits.after: Best wave: a Q-W slow push crashed on his Destiny timer — if he Gates while your wave is mid, you lose the plate trade. Worst wave: a frozen wave at his tower with the ball behind you — that is where he walks into 200 and cards you. Crash timing: shove with a destination in mind; mid waves are bus tickets, not chores.

edits.before: If Twisted Fate gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Pick a Card (Gold) extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with Q-W clears and stay relevant through Shockwave threat.
edits.after: A fed Twisted Fate does not need to win lane — he Gates to a side lane and wins there. Stay outside 200, farm with Q-W, and ping the Destiny channel every single time it starts, however far behind you are.

edits.before: Carry through the ball — no champion controls teamfight space like Orianna; one Shockwave on three is a won game, and you decide when it happens.
edits.after: Carry through zone control: his ceiling is one Gold Card pick, yours is a Shockwave on three, and the fight after it is a 5v4 for ten seconds.

edits.before: You are the fight: ball on the diver, Shockwave the clump, Dissonance the retreat. Position behind your front line and let the sphere do the dying.
edits.after: You are the fight and he is the pick: ball on your frontliner, Shockwave their clump, and hold Dissonance for whoever Gates in behind you.

edits.before: Ahead, run the clock: shove with Q-W, zone Twisted Fate off every contact with ball threat, and rotate first to rivers — your Shockwave makes every skirmish a 5v4 audition.
edits.after: Ahead, take the tempo: shove with Q-W so he cannot leave without losing the wave, ward his Gate landing spots, and be at the next objective before Destiny is even up.

notes: Packet defect is a FALSE POSITIVE: suspectNames flags 'Gold Card' in spikes[2].text as a probable wrong name for 'Wild Cards'. Gold Card is the correct in-game name for the Pick a Card (W) select the page is describing, and the page already uses the 'Pick a Card (Gold)' convention elsewhere. Left alone. Chart: phases[0..3].side read 'Skill' against content win[0..3] 'Orianna'; win[] matched the packet levelChart and the whys, so the four sides were moved and their whys rewritten in one atomic group. Ratings untouched. Deliberately NOT written: I drafted and then removed a Banshee's Veil recommendation, because whether a spell shield stops a Gold Card applied through a basic attack is exactly the kind of eligibility question the kits do not answer — recorded as unverified rather than guessed. The content layer on this matchup is already specific and largely un-templated; almost all the defects were in the full layer. Left templated but not grounded: report[6].t, report[7].t and report[12].t are Orianna-generic but contain nothing false.
